questions.q: Why does 'the Bible is true because it says so' just go in a circle?
questions.answer: It uses the Bible to prove the Bible, so it never gets outside the loop. We need reasons from outside it, like how many accurate ancient copies we have.

questions.q: How would you answer a friend who says we only have error-filled copies?
questions.answer: There are over 6,000 New Testament copies, and they agree more than 95 percent of the time. The differences are small, like spelling or little words, and none change what it teaches.

questions.q: If the Bible really is reliable, what should change in your life this week?
questions.answer: One example: "I'll read something Paul wrote this week, trusting it's really what he wrote, and take it seriously instead of ignoring it."
